answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, LLaMA, and have exhibited transformative abilities to generate remarkably fluent and cogent long-form text in response to user queries.
answer_1.outputs: machine-generated text that is perturbed to evade detection while preserving fluency and semantic consistency

answer_2.quote: We use the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC) to summarize detection accuracy for our attack framework under various thresholds. We also measure the True Positive Rate at a 5% False Positive Rate (TPR at 5% FPR)... To measure text quality, we measure the perplexity of the attacked text against GPT-NEO-2.7B.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a crowd-sourced human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk).
answer_4.guideline: three MTurk workers evaluated whether the perturbed text remained indistinguishable from human-written text in terms of fluency and semantic consistency.
